definition.name: covering_net
definition.definition: An epsilon-covering net (or epsilon-net) of a metric space (T, d) is a subset S of T such that every point x in T has some point s in S with d(x,s) <= epsilon. For the unit sphere S^{d-1} in C^d with the Euclidean metric, an epsilon-net of size at most (3/epsilon)^{2d} exists (Vershynin, Corollary 4.2.11 [Ver18]). Covering nets are used in the concentration argument of Theorem 1.2: one first bounds the maximum error over the net, then extends to all directions via a Lipschitz argument (Vershynin, Lemma 4.4.2).
